description: Questions and answers from the FAQ page (check-in and check-out, which house is open in summer, distance to the slopes, half board, dogs, parking, extra beds, cancellation, arrival). Optionally filter with a search term. Returns the matching questions with answers and the FAQ page URL.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.

query.description: Optional search term, e.g. "Parken" or "hond". Leave out for all questions.

name: get_faq

code.description: Error code when ok is false, e.g. VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Readable error message when ok is false.

ok.description: true on success; false with code and message on an error.

title: Frequently asked questions
